period_note: Extracted from Trust Bank's own annual-report-embedded 'Audit Committee and the Board Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table (a BSEC corporate-governance-mandated disclosure). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 of the same year (the source table's own column header reads '01 Jan to <quarter-end date>'), not discrete-quarter figures, flagged via the _cumulative suffix; balance-sheet items are the period-end snapshot. BASIS MISMATCH FLAGGED: this table's own text states the Board approved the CONSOLIDATED financial statements for quarterly disclosure every year it appears (2018, 2020-2025) — this differs from Trust Bank's main Q4/annual series in this dataset, which is SOLO (Bank-only, unconsolidated) basis for balance-sheet/income-statement items (see sources.json top-level reporting_basis, confirmed 2026-08-26). Verified numerically for FY2022: this table's own Q4/full-year column reports Total Assets 421,960 (Consolidated) vs this dataset's SOLO-basis FY2022 Q4 Total Assets 417,902.46 — a 0.97% gap, consistent with Trust Bank's small subsidiaries (Trust Bank Investment Ltd, Trust Bank Securities Ltd, Trust Axiata Digital Ltd) being added net of intercompany eliminations on consolidation, not a data error. Do not directly mix these CONSOLIDATED Q1-Q3 figures with this bank's SOLO-basis Q4/annual figures without adjusting for this basis gap. Source document is FY2022's own annual report (contemporaneous). Cross-checked against the FY2023 report's comparative column for the same quarter: all line items shown here match exactly. (Note: the FY2023 report's comparative column for FY2022 Q4 — outside this file's scope — shows Total Shareholders' Equity 20,124 vs 20,214 in FY2022's own report, an isolated ~0.4% discrepancy recorded in sources.json; it does not affect Q1-Q3, which match exactly.)
